title: Value of a Boolean list
statement: For a finite Boolean list, define its value recursively by assigning the empty list value zero and assigning $2v+b$ to a list with first bit $b$ and tail value $v$, where the Boolean bit $b$ is identified with $0$ or $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean list
